AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mugirl newborn
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a newborn. [PAWN_possessive] life revolves around drinking milk and sleeping.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: The Rescued Mugirl
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was rescued by an anti-slavery organisation at a young age, allowing [PAWN_pronoun] to escape the same fate of enslavement as [PAWN_possessive] compatriots. [PAWN_pronoun] was placed in a camp hidden deep in the mountains, where [PAWN_pronoun] spent a happy childhood— for this race, such an experience was undoubtedly a luxury.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Child Labour
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] no longer remembers when [PAWN_pronoun] started engaging in heavy physical labour. As a child labourer, [PAWN_nameDef] served as cheap labour in factories or mines, sweating all day under harsh production conditions. To maximise the exploitation of [PAWN_nameDef]'s surplus value, [PAWN_pronoun] was forbidden from resting for more than ten minutes, let alone receiving basic cultural education.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Farm Slave
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has lived on a rural farm since [PAWN_possessive] earliest memories, driven by the owner to work diligently and without complaint. [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was spent tending crops and livestock, with blisters on [PAWN_possessive] hands always forming and breaking. For years, [PAWN_pronoun] only received the minimum amount of food on the farm. [PAWN_nameDef] does not know where this unpalatable paste comes from, because [PAWN_pronoun] has always been forbidden from entering the kitchen.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Domestic Servant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a domestic servant in a wealthy household, mastering household service skills under the butler's strict training and being responsible for addressing all daily needs of the master's family. [PAWN_nameDef] undertook heavy household chores from a young age, yet lacked experience in pet care- after all, [PAWN_nameDef] had likely already occupied their ecological niche.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Yield Enhancement Experiment Subject
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up as an experiment subject in an agricultural research institute, undergoing many long-term medical observations and experiments, and became familiar with numerous medical terms. The managers told [PAWN_nameDef] that outside the institute, dangers lurked everywhere, and if [PAWN_pronoun] left, there was a risk of death at any time. During childhood, [PAWN_pronoun] never saw the true form of feed, nor did [PAWN_pronoun] ever see [PAWN_possessive] own kind.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mugirls' Liberator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] had a rare and happy childhood after being rescued by an anti-slavery organisation. During that time in the camp, [PAWN_pronoun] mastered many combat skills. After reaching adulthood, [PAWN_pronoun] devoted [PAWN_possessive] life to liberating more compatriots, eventually becoming a steadfast anti-slavery organisation fighter.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mugirl Colonist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] came of age in our colony. [PAWN_possessive] story continues.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mine Labour
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] secured work in an underground mine thanks to [PAWN_possessive] robust physique, barely scraping by on meager wages. In the pitch-black, dust-filled mine shafts, [PAWN_nameDef] swung picks and pushed mine carts day and night, meeting increasingly demanding quotas. With [PAWN_possessive] strained finances and virtually no leave, [PAWN_pronoun] avoided medical care, unwilling to undergo health checks that would disrupt [PAWN_possessive] work.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Construction Site Labour
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a fairly skilled construction labour. Starting with miscellaneous tasks on construction sites, [PAWN_nameDef] gradually accumulated various operational experiences, capable of taking on roles such as plumbing, bricklaying, and painting. [PAWN_nameDef] particularly enjoys the wonderful feeling of using a nail gun to shoot nails, that short and powerful gas ejection sound is especially pleasing to the ear. The immense physical exertion on the site led [PAWN_objective] to develop a habit of eating at a nearby small canteen, after all, who has the energy to cook for themselves after working non-stop?

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Farm Labour
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has long been engaged in crop cultivation and livestock management on a large farm. [PAWN_nameDef] carries the scent of soil and hay, and the daily fieldwork has made [PAWN_objective] familiar with the growth cycles of various crops and animal habits. During the off-season, [PAWN_nameDef] often hears news about nearby farms from the farm owner. It is said that a cruel farm owner who keeps a large number of Mugirls often sends people to burn, kill, and rob everywhere, and [PAWN_pronoun] is glad that [PAWN_pronoun] does not have to take up arms to defend the farm.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Factory Worker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years seeking livelihood opportunities among various assembly line factories in industrial parks, trying to create better living conditions with [PAWN_possessive] hands. If the fruits of [PAWN_possessive] labour were not legally unprotected, [PAWN_pronoun] might have continued working in the same sweatshop. [PAWN_nameDef] has worked in various jobs such as assembly, quality inspection, loading and unloading, and security, leaving sweat and toil in every position. Although forced by life circumstances to receive little education, [PAWN_pronoun] still harbours a longing for school.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Cattle Ranch Slave
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] endured immense hardship as a milking slave on a "cattle" farm, never qualifying to be treated as a human. Initially confined to narrow pens and exploited by the farm owner, [PAWN_pronoun] later transitioned from being a "dairy cow" to managing livestock for [PAWN_possessive] master when labour was short, operating machinery and processing fresh milk. However, [PAWN_pronoun] often struggled to handle the temperamental cattle and was frequently attacked by the herd.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Pedlar
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] made a living running small goods retail, once prospering through business acumen and owning [PAWN_possessive] own shop. However, economic crisis, plague and warfare followed in quick succession. When [PAWN_pronoun] tried to defend [PAWN_possessive] business with weapons during several large-scale looting events, [PAWN_possessive] property was ultimately plundered by frenzied crowds. After regrouping, [PAWN_pronoun] mobilized all social connections to borrow funds and resumed [PAWN_possessive] life of hawking wares while travelling through streets and alleys.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Household Carer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has experience working as a household carer for multiple families, developing a particular fondness for child care and cooking. [PAWN_pronoun] would rise before dawn to prepare breakfast and handle household chores until late at night. Although [PAWN_pronoun] put considerable effort into refining culinary techniques and studying childcare knowledge, [PAWN_pronoun] still struggled to meet the nitpicking expectations of demanding employers, often reminiscing about [PAWN_possessive] own unrealized artistic dreams.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Underground Idol
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is a performance idol in urban underground clubs. As a Mugirl, [PAWN_pronoun] naturally possesses an excellent appearance and was selected by a talent agency as a trainee at a young age. However, after a few years, [PAWN_pronoun] failed to make it to the end on the idol path and was eliminated. Subsequently, [PAWN_pronoun] continued performing in underground clubs, desperately attracting audience attention to make a living.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Nightclub Staff
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] dropped out of school and wandered into urban nightlife, becoming an employee under the lure of high salaries, responsible for checking customers' ages and maintaining order. [PAWN_nameDef] received basic firearms training and occasionally needed to show the weapon to intimidate drunk troublemakers. However, the inverted day-night schedule disrupted [PAWN_pronoun] routine, and [PAWN_pronoun] was solely focused on "making money", with no time to care for [PAWN_possessive] health.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gladiator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is an experienced gladiator, making a living by participating in arena fights for substantial rewards. Through years of rigorous training in combat skills, [PAWN_pronoun] has mastered various weapons, hoping to prevail in the cruel and bloody contests of the arena. With limited medical facilities available, [PAWN_pronoun] had to learn folk remedies to treat injuries and illnesses.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Gang Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] embarked on a life of crime as an adult, living on the edge with street fights and gang brawls becoming daily occurrences. On the lawless fringes of society, [PAWN_pronoun] served local crime bosses, chasing dreams of getting rich overnight. Due to [PAWN_possessive] inexperience, [PAWN_pronoun] backed the wrong side in internal gang conflicts, became ostracized, and was forced into a life on the run, constantly moving to avoid detection.
